statement_summary: CIP Senior Manager named; delegations documented
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
CIP policy topics approved by the CIP Senior Manager at least every 15 calendar months
CIP-002 identifications reviewed and approved at least every 15 calendar months; change triggers
Security terms and annual review for key vendors
Potential NERC noncompliance reported within 5 business days; Self-Report decision
CIP evidence retained at least three calendar years
Unique accounts including SCADA HMIs; shared accounts retired by 2026-12-31
MFA for all remote paths into OT, VPN, and SaaS; phishing-resistant for admins
Same-day access removal; keys and badges collected
Vendor remote access named, off by default, recorded, disabled on demand, monitored
Only necessary routable access to Substation N and E; checked after every change
Relay and gateway passwords unique per substation and changed after contractor visits
Substation physical access based on need; key log reconciled quarterly
Reportable Cyber Security Incident determination and E-ISAC notice (1-hour internal target)
Annual test of the incident response plan; never beyond 36 calendar months
DOE-417, EOP-004, and breach notice deadlines per the P08 matrix
regulatory_driver: NERC EOP-004-4 R2; DOE-417; Fla. Stat. 501.171

statement_summary: Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Delete customer SSNs after the credit decision
Offline or immutable SCADA backups restore-tested quarterly
Annual awareness training for all staff; phishing exercises
Contractor laptops reviewed before connecting to relays or SCADA
Removable media scanned at a kiosk before use on OT
Approved generative AI tools only; no Restricted data
